name: Higashiizu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Higashiizu town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a ring and swept strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Higashiizu, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1969.

features.role: Higashiizu town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a ring and swept strokes
